obs = observe()

        candidate = c

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
